blocks.text: DAKAR—Jamesray Mishael Ajido has the skills to compete against the world’s best young swimmers. What he lacks is the height and reach that often make the difference in a sport decided by fractions of a second. That disadvantage was evident on Sunday when the Filipino swimmer finished fifth in the men’s 100-meter butterfly final at […]...
